programmes.d: In this track showdown, GT2 RS wins over SLS and F-Type wins over Street Triple.
The Hyundai i30 N takes on Honda Civic Type R in this track showdown.
Join the Mk2 Escort at the Woodpecker Rally then a track battle between the McLaren P1 and Porsche 918 Spyder.
evo's Editorial Director, Harry Metcalfe, drives the 2012 Mille Miglia in a 1955 Alfa 1900 SS across Italy.
Watch the showdown between the Porsche GT3 RS, McLaren 750S and Radical SR3 XXR.

Steve wants to run his 1954 Oldsmobile in a thousand-mile road race. Dan faces a tight budget, a tough schedule and race rules. Jim wants Fantomworks to bring his 1977 Spitfire out of a coma; but Dan puts his foot down when safety issues are discovered.

Michael wants a new convertible top for his 1953 Morgan, but the Fantomworks team has no reference, no template and no anchor points. Butch entrusted his 1969 Camaro to a restoration rip-off artist. Can Fantomworks fix the worst work they’ve ever seen?

George wants his 1967 Chevelle to be perfect, but his car has had more rats than repairs and the engine bay is too small for his dreams. Brian’s 1960 Lincoln is full of surprises, and he moment something else is fixed, a new problem surfaces.

Gary wants to restore a 1964 Mercedes 230SL, but his tight budget launches Dan into a headlong battle with a 50-year-old interior and a shattered cam shaft. Al wants to restore his father’s GTO, but FantomWorks discover it’s not the car Al thinks it is.

Joe challenges FantomWorks to build a replica of a legendary 1953 hydroplane that set a water speed record. Andy wants the perfect split window top for his 1963 corvette, but Dan finds hidden problems that launch a cross country search for parts.

Mike’s 1939 Hudson Coupe-Convertible is the only survivor of three that were built. He wants Fantomworks to restore it to original condition – even though nobody knows what that looks like. Jim wants his 1970 Nova to be the ultimate dragster.

Nikkos wants a spectacular 1968 Mustang Fastback resto-mod. The all-metal masterpiece catches the eye of someone who wants it at any cost. Jim and Arlene want to enjoy their 45th anniversary in the same 1969 Firebird they rode in on their wedding day.

Kansas City Royals pitcher Tim Collins wants a ‘super-fast’ 1968 Mustang, but Dan has to first undo a nightmare combination of bad repairs and unsafe systems. Bob needs a FantomWorks reality check to get his beloved 1950 Willy’s Jeep back on the road.
Ryan is challenged to paint a Harley Trike in the spirit of Van Gogh's "Starry Night," and Kevin finds a car that could be one the most valuable ones Danny has ever seen.
Danny wants Ryan to fix a bad flame job on his beloved police cruiser that's been sitting in the shop for years.
Danny acquires a '62 Caddy which he hopes will be a huge flip. Ryan devises a secret plan for the car behind Danny's back, but when Danny finds out there's some explaining to do.
Danny tries to get the derailed '62 Caddy project back on track, while Ryan tries to make amends for a mishap by finding a flip or two for the shop.
Danny scores a 1967 Mustang that he hopes he can turn into another Count's Kustoms masterpiece. He visits a local muscle car collection for inspiration.
Danny makes a plan to put the Count's Kustoms touch on a classic Harley Davidson that he hopes to sell for a big profit.
Danny acquires a '74 Ford F100 he can't wait to trick out and flip for a big profit. But after The Count falls in love with the truck and decides he wants to keep it.
When Danny challenges the guys to come up with innovative money-making ideas for the shop, Shannon proposes building a bike.
Mike gifts all the guys with their own drifter trikes, under one condition--they must customize them, then race them at the local track.
Former Guns & Roses guitarist DJ Ashba arrives at Count's Kustoms in a 2004 Lamborghini Murcielago that he wants turned into the ultimate "mancar".
Danny gets started on a project that he's been waiting a long time to tackle, a 1971 Chevy C10 Pick Up. He plans to flip it for a big profit.
Danny continues his El Caminos love affair with a 1975 beauty.
Review the McLaren 675LT and Proteus C-Type. Then, compare the Renaultsport Megane against Honda Civic Type R.
The Porsche 959 redefines its 80s performance. Then, test the fun of the Toyota GT86 and Mazda MX-5!
In this track battle, Jaguar F-Type takes on the Porsche 911 while the Morgan Plus 8 takes on the BMW R9T.
Race in the F56 Mini Challenge at Brands Hatch. Then, compare the BMW M4 with the M5.
Dive into Audi Sport's journey in rallying, Quattro revolution and its iconic performance cars.
Explore the groundbreaking RS2 and B5 RS4. Then, Audi Sport transforms rally prowess into road legends!
Join a thrilling Mille Miglia journey in a Bugatti Veyron Vitesse over 1,000 exhilarating miles!
Follow the Aston Martin Valkyrie from Silverstone to Le Mans in a road trip showcasing power and design!
Experience Goodwood Festival of Speed as legendary cars and drivers tear up the hill in nonstop celebration!
Go on a 1000-mile Mille Miglia rally with stunning Ferraris, wild traffic jams and unforgettable scenery!
Explore Japan's icons as evo tests the Impreza 22B, LFA and GT-R Nismo in a celebration of pure performance!
Checks out the new Porsche Cayman GT4, which is powered by a 3.8-L engine with 385 hp.
Join a 1,000-mile Lamborghini Espada adventure, mixing vintage charm, stunning roads and pure Lambo spirit!
Explore Geneva's standouts, from Civic Concept to Model X, as well as the bold cars and concepts in Paris!
Ride with Richard Meaden in a rare 1969 Porsche 911 S rally car. Then, see Chris Harris in a GT3 RS!
Explore the Mercedes-AMG G 63's wild power! Then, Henry Catchpole drives the Aston N430 in Scotland!
EVO editors test nine contenders and break down their choices on the road to crowning Car of the Year 2023!
Five judges push nine cars across road and track to reveal each model's character!
The judges debate all nine cars and ultimately crown evo Car of the Year for 2024!
Meaden attempts a world record! Then, witness the M5 on a frozen lake and a drive in the LFA!
